payload.body: You tend to let a need go unspoken until it appears as a sharp reply, a quick change of mood, or resentment over something small. The dishes, the late message, or the changed plan becomes harder to tolerate than it would have been on its own. This usually happens because you learned that asking earlier would not help or would make you seem demanding. Say what would help before listing everything that has already gone wrong.
